claims.quote: The checkered pupfish, Cualac tessellatus, is a cyprinodontid endemic to a handful of springs in the Río Verde valley, San Luis Potosí, Mexico.
Endemic to a handful of natural springs in the Río Verde valley, San Luis Potosí state, Central Mexico and currently listed as 'Endangered' by the IUCN.

regions.name: Río Verde
regions.quote: The checkered pupfish, Cualac tessellatus, is a cyprinodontid endemic to a handful of springs in the Río Verde valley, San Luis Potosí, Mexico.

regions.name: Río Pánuco
regions.quote: The valley is believed to have once been filled by a large lake and the relict springs are part of the elevated Río (river) Verde basin which later drains into the much larger Río Pánuco system.

regions.name: Media Luna
regions.quote: C. tessellatus can be found in the Media Luna lagoon system, a popular spot with recreational scuba divers, as well as a few smaller lagoons including 'El aguaje', 'Los anteojitos', 'Laguna de San Bartolo' and probably others.
